receiptScanner.title: Receipt scanning
receiptScanner.subtitle: Upload a receipt photo, review the expense preview, and approve to save. For better OCR, crop to the receipt only (no table in the background) and make sure the text is sharp and well lit.
receiptScanner.step1Desc: Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP (up to 2MB). Before sending, crop the image so only the receipt is in frame — less background means better text recognition.
receiptScanner.selectFileHint: Select a file to see the photo preview.
receiptScanner.step2Desc: You can edit the content before approving. After saving, expenses will be appended to the current file.

receiptScanner.expensesRead: Expenses were read. Review the content and approve.
